services.name: Banana Boat
services.desc: Hold on tight! Get ready for an action-packed ride across the waves with our Banana Boat Rides in South Padre Island. It’s the perfect way to add a splash of fun and adventure to your beach day. Gather your friends and family, and book your ride today to make some unforgettable memories on the water. A banana boat ride offers a thrilling experience on a large inflatable raft, accommodating up to six passengers. Life jackets are provided for all riders to ensure safety. Expect to get wet and possibly fall in, which adds to the excitement. Wear a swimsuit or comfortable water-friendly clothing. services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: As the sun begins to set over South Padre Island, casting a golden glow across the water, there’s no better place to be than on our Private Sunset Cruise. Watch the sky explode with vibrant hues of orange, pink, and purple as you unwind on the tranquil waves. Spaces for this breathtaking escape are limited and book up fast. Secure your spot on the water today! You may bring your own cooler with food and beverages, including alcoholic beverages. Glass containers are not allowed on the boat. Need to grab food and drinks before boarding? Our on-site restaurant, Lobo Del Mar Cafe, is located right at the departure point. services.name: Dolphin Cruise
services.desc: Experience the magic of dolphins and other wildlife in their natural habitat on our private cruise. Create lasting memories as you watch these incredible creatures play and glide through the water. Perfect for a relaxing, family-friendly adventure, our cruise offers an unforgettable experience for all ages. Book your trip today! We’ve got you covered with bottled water and a licensed, experienced captain to ensure your trip is both safe and enjoyable. Want to bring your own snacks and drinks? Feel free!
